name: La Coolmena LLC

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ted Carter
reviewSamples.text: The quality of food here was top TIER!! Better than son restaurants I have reviewed. Everything made to order so there was a slight wait. For loaded nachos I waited about 7 mins but totally worth it. Once I started eating, I couldn’t stop! Definitely recommend
